descriptions.text: 32bit decoder serial number (derived from MCU chip ID)
Hard Reset (clear PERM, SRVL, ZERO space)
Consist FN1-FN8: bit=1 routes that function via the consist address instead of the base address.
Consist FN0, FN9-FN68: bit=1 routes that function via the consist address instead of the base address.
Minimal speed. Together with CV5 (max) and CV6 (mid) defines a 3-point speed conversion table.
Acceleration - milliseconds per speed step increment.
Deceleration - milliseconds per speed step decrement.
Dead-man interval. Decoder stops if no speed command is received within this time.
Custom 28->126 speed step conversion table (default linear).
92kHz - can be used with coreless motors
46kHz - compromise between high and low frequency PWM
Motor PWM frequency. Selected at decoder startup; power-cycle after changing.
Motor EMF sample point. Depends on motor type and PCB layout; too low = dodgy/no motor spin. 3-pole >=100, 5-pole >=50, coreless as low as 0.
Buffer cap used by CPU only
Motor RPM max fine-tune. <128 reduces top speed, 128 = mid-point, >128 increases top speed.
Motor maximum current. H-bridge throttles above Imax; motor stops and CV30 flag is set above 75% Imax.
Distance scale (slow spinning). 128 = mid-point (default), 255 = x1.99, 1 = x0.08.
Distance scale (fast spinning). Same scaling as CV61 but applied at higher speeds.
Distance trim (forward/reverse balance). >128 trims towards forward, <128 towards reverse.
Model scale (1:N), used for speed/distance calculations (e.g. mm/s -> km/h).
Vendor ID (reads as 13/0x0d). Writing triggers the listed reset operation; rejected while motor is running.
Protocol support bitmask (read-only, currently DCC only).
Decoder programming Lock KEY. CVs only respond if CV15==CV16. Writing 255 copies CV16 here (unlock).
Decoder programming Lock ID. Should not be 0 per RCN-225.
Automatic STOP on asymmetrical DCC signal detection.
Decoder error information. Write 0 to clear.
Decoder maximum temperature. Motor stops and CV30 flag is set if exceeded.
Maximum track voltage. Motor stops and CV30 flag is set if exceeded.
AUX maximum combined current. AUX ports switch off for 1 sec if exceeded; CV30 flag at 50%.
DCC address management mode - indicates how the currently active address was selected.
Trim channel-1 timing. TTS1[us] = 80 + CV47 + rnd(CV48 & 0xf).
Generate channel-1 timing jitter (0 = no jitter). See CV47 formula.
Trim channel-2 timing. TTS2[us] = 193 + CV49 + rnd(CV50 & 0xf).
Generate channel-2 timing jitter (0 = no jitter). See CV49 formula.
Channel-2 DYN tuple selection (part 1). Clearing a bit suppresses that tuple.
Channel-2 DYN tuple selection (part 2). Clearing a bit suppresses that tuple.
16bit hardware ID (0xHHLL identifies the decoder model).
User variable - free for user specific information.
User variable - free for user specific information.
Extended vendor ID. 0x0109 (=265) identifies the RTB project.
FN# to disable the acceleration ramp (see CV3).
FN# to disable the deceleration ramp (see CV4).
Dim Headlight 1 - max PWM duty (93kHz), 0=always off, 255=full brightness.
Dim Headlight 2 - max PWM duty (93kHz), 0=always off, 255=full brightness.

SUSI option 1 - data/functions sent to SUSI slaves.
SUSI option 2 - function groups sent to SUSI slaves.
SUSI clock speed. 0 disables SUSI; 1..255 sets the cycle time (10..500us range per SUSI spec).
Servo left boundary (must be less than CV204). <128 left of center, 128 center, >128 right of center.
Servo right boundary (must be greater than CV203). <128 left of center, 128 center, >128 right of center.
Servo position target within the boundaries defined by CV203..CV204.
Coupler attach distance [mm] motion path definition (packed nibbles: push/pull).
Coupler attach speed [step/126] motion path definition (packed nibbles: push/pull).
Coupler detach distance [mm] motion path definition (packed nibbles: push/pull).
Coupler detach speed [step/126] motion path definition (packed nibbles: push/pull).
Port testing min PWM duty (lower nibble)
Port testing max PWM duty (upper nibble)
Port testing PWM duty range used for extended port testing.
Port testing index. 0=off, 1-32=activate that port, 255=activate all 32 ports. Warning: port(s) stay active until reset to 0 or power cycle.
Port bus mode for the 32 extended ports.
Accumulated distance travelled (signed 32bit, little endian). Read via xPOM for atomicity.
Current model speed (unsigned 16bit, little endian). Read via xPOM for atomicity.
Total DCC frame counter (unsigned 32bit, little endian). Wraps after ~414 days at 120fps.
DCC frames per second. Typically 100-120; higher is better.
DCC addressings per second - how often this decoder is addressed by the command station.
Track voltage delta (right - left), midpoint 128, decivolt units. 128=0.0V, 120=-0.8V, 140=+1.2V.
Decoder reset reason - source of the most recent MCU reset.
Watchdog reset counter - should remain 0 under normal operation.
Brown-out reset counter - increases with poor power conditions (e.g. dirty track).
Software reset counter - increases when firmware triggers its own reset.
